SELECT s.id, s.class_id AS classId, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.class_name, ''), cg.name) AS className, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.course_name, ''), co.name) AS courseName, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.teacher_name, ''), t.name) AS teacherName, s.lesson_date AS lessonDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.room, s.status, (SELECT cs.id FROM class_suspend cs WHERE cs.schedule_id = s.id AND cs.status = '已休课' LIMIT 1) AS suspendId FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = s.class_id LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = s.teacher_id WHERE s.lesson_date >= #{start} AND s.lesson_date <= #{end} AND s.class_id IN #{id} AND s.status = '待上课'
AND (COALESCE(NULLIF(s.class_name, ''), cg.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(NULLIF(s.course_name, ''), co.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(NULLIF(s.teacher_name, ''), t.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY s.lesson_date, s.start_time, s.id
